17"""Re-measure two Pretune runs' selected configs in one process. 

18 

19Pretune writes ``latency_p50_ms`` from a fresh measurement taken inside the 

20process that tuned the shape. Comparing a baseline run against an ours run 

21therefore compares two processes separated by the training stage, and at small 

22shape sizes that between-process error term is larger than the effect under 

23test: on a T-Head PPU, rows whose two runs had selected the *same* config still 

24reported 82.6%-108.8% relative throughput. 

25 

26This command removes that error term. It reads both Pretune CSV artifacts, 

27takes the config each run selected, and measures both configs for every shape 

28back to back in one process. The default alternates which side is measured 

29first; ``--measurement-order sequential`` finishes each side's trials in order. 

30Only the latency columns of the two inputs are rewritten, so 

31``compare.py`` consumes the result unchanged. 

32 

33CLI arguments: 

34 * ``--baseline`` and ``--ours`` are the Pretune CSV artifacts to re-measure. 

35 ``--shape-config`` and ``--flagtune-config`` must be the ones both runs used; 

36 rows are joined to shape records by the original input row index. 

37 * ``--trials`` sets measurements per config per sweep and ``--repeats`` sets 

38 how many independent sweeps run. The reported latency is the median over 

39 sweeps of the median over trials. 

40 * ``--latency-warmup``, ``--latency-iter``, ``--benchmark-mode``, and 

41 ``--benchmark-retries`` set the Triton timing protocol. 

42 * ``--noise-floor-ms`` marks shapes too small for that protocol to resolve. 

43 Marked rows are reported separately rather than dropped. 

44 * ``--regression-threshold-pct`` selects which rows the summary lists. A 

45 listed row is only reported as a confirmed regression when its shortfall 

46 also exceeds its own spread across sweeps, because a row that moves more 

47 between sweeps than it falls below the baseline has not been shown to 

48 regress at all. 

49 

50Artifacts are ``baseline_pretune.csv``, ``ours_pretune.csv``, and 

51``rebench_summary.json`` under ``--output``. Rows that either run did not 

52complete are passed through untouched and counted as skipped. 

53 

54Unlike Pretune this command is deliberately single-process and single-device. 

55Both sides of each comparison must stay in the same process and on the same 

56device, so Pretune's per-worker device pinning is unavailable. 

57``--device`` therefore restricts this process to one device before the FlagGems 

58runtime is imported; importing it later caches the visible device count and the 

59restriction stops taking effect. An already-set backend visibility variable is 

60authoritative and is never overwritten. 

61""" 

62 

63from __future__ import annotations

81# Importing anything under ``flag_gems`` runs its package initializer, which 

82# probes the backend and caches the visible device count. Every such import is 

83# therefore deferred until ``main`` has pinned this process to one device.

85DEFAULT_DEVICE = "0" 

86VISIBILITY_VARIABLES = ( 

87 "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", 

88 "ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES", 

89 "HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES", 

90 "MACA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", 

91 "MUSA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", 

92)

94DEFAULT_REPEATS = 3 

95DEFAULT_NOISE_FLOOR_MS = 0.002 

96DEFAULT_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD_PCT = 95.0 

97LATENCY_SOURCE = "libtuner_fixed_config_rebench" 

98SIDES = ("baseline", "ours") 

99REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ( 

100 "input_row_index",

103 "best_config",

105 "latency_p50_ms",

111)

114class RebenchError(RuntimeError): 

115 """Report a user-facing input, join, or measurement failure."""

118def _pin_single_device(token: str) -> str: 

119 """Restrict this process to one device and describe the active setting. 

120 

121 Args: 

122 token: Launcher device token to expose when nothing is pinned yet. 

123 

124 Returns: 

125 A ``NAME=value`` description of the visibility setting now in force, 

126 used in diagnostics. 

127 

128 Notes: 

129 A non-empty backend visibility variable already present in the 

130 environment is authoritative and is left untouched, so a caller that 

131 pinned a specific device keeps it. Otherwise the CUDA-family variable 

132 is set; on a backend with its own variable, export that variable before 

133 invoking this command. 

134 

135 Limitations: 

136 This must run before the FlagGems runtime is imported. The backend 

137 caches its visible device count during package initialization, and a 

138 later change to the environment no longer has any effect. 

139 """ 

140 for name in VISIBILITY_VARIABLES: 

141 current = str(os.environ.get(name, "")).strip() 

142 if current: 

143 return f"{name}={current}" 

144 os.environ[VISIBILITY_VARIABLES[0]] = str(token) 

145 return f"{VISIBILITY_VARIABLES[0]}={token}"

220def _read_pretune_csv(path: Path, label: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[str]]: 

221 """Read one Pretune CSV and verify the columns this command rewrites.""" 

222 try: 

223 with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream: 

224 reader = csv.DictReader(stream) 

225 fieldnames = list(reader.fieldnames or []) 

226 rows = [dict(row) for row in reader] 

227 except OSError as exc: 

228 raise RebenchError(f"cannot read {label} CSV {path}: {exc}") from exc 

229 if not rows: 

230 raise RebenchError(f"{label} CSV {path} has no rows") 

231 missing = [name for name in REQUIRED_COLUMNS if name not in fieldnames] 

232 if missing: 

233 raise RebenchError( 

234 f"{label} CSV {path} is missing required columns: {missing}. " 

235 "Re-measurement needs schema v3 Pretune output." 

236 ) 

237 return rows, fieldnames 

238 

239 

240def _index_rows( 

241 rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, str]], label: str 

242) -> dict[int, dict[str, str]]: 

243 """Index Pretune rows by their original input row index.""" 

244 indexed: dict[int, dict[str, str]] = {} 

245 for row in rows: 

246 try: 

247 index = int(row["input_row_index"]) 

248 except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc: 

249 raise RebenchError( 

250 f"{label} CSV has a row with an unusable input_row_index" 

251 ) from exc 

252 if index in indexed: 

253 raise RebenchError(f"{label} CSV repeats input_row_index {index}") 

254 indexed[index] = dict(row) 

255 return indexed 

256 

257 

258def _selected_config(row: Mapping[str, str], label: str, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]: 

259 """Parse one run's selected config into a flattened config record.""" 

260 text = (row.get("best_config") or "").strip() 

261 if not text: 

262 raise RebenchError(f"{label} row {index} has no best_config") 

263 try: 

264 config = json.loads(text) 

265 except json.JSONDecodeError as exc: 

266 raise RebenchError( 

267 f"{label} row {index} has an unparsable best_config: {exc}" 

268 ) from exc 

269 if not isinstance(config, Mapping) or not config: 

270 raise RebenchError(f"{label} row {index} best_config is not a config mapping") 

271 return dict(config) 

272 

273 

274def _resolve_dtypes(dtypes: str, tensor_count: int) -> list[str]: 

275 """Normalize and broadcast requested dtypes to the tensor-recipe count.""" 

276 from triton.flagtune.contract.identity import normalize_dtype_name 

277 

278 requested = [item.strip() for item in dtypes.split(",") if item.strip()] 

279 if not requested: 

280 raise RebenchError("--dtypes must contain at least one dtype") 

281 try: 

282 requested = [normalize_dtype_name(item) for item in requested] 

283 except ValueError as exc: 

284 raise RebenchError(str(exc)) from exc 

285 if len(requested) == 1: 

286 return requested * tensor_count 

287 if len(requested) != tensor_count: 

288 raise RebenchError( 

289 f"--dtypes has {len(requested)} values but benchmark.tensors has " 

290 f"{tensor_count} inputs" 

291 ) 

292 return requested 

293 

294 

295def _sweep_quantiles( 

296 trials: Sequence[tuple[float, float, float]], 

297) -> tuple[float, float, float]: 

298 """Reduce one sweep's trials to a median p20/p50/p80 triple.""" 

299 return tuple(statistics.median(values) for values in zip(*trials)) 

300 

301 

302def _reduce_sweeps( 

303 sweeps: Sequence[tuple[float, float, float]], 

304) -> tuple[float, float, float]: 

305 """Reduce per-sweep quantiles to the reported median triple.""" 

306 return tuple(statistics.median(values) for values in zip(*sweeps)) 

307 

308 

309def _rewrite_latency( 

310 row: Mapping[str, str], 

311 quantiles: tuple[float, float, float], 

312 *, 

313 warmup: int, 

314 iterations: int, 

315 trials: int, 

316) -> dict[str, str]: 

317 """Copy one Pretune row with its latency columns replaced.""" 

318 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.reporting.schema import format_ms 

319 

320 updated = dict(row) 

321 p20, p50, p80 = quantiles 

322 updated["latency_p20_ms"] = format_ms(p20) 

323 updated["latency_p50_ms"] = format_ms(p50) 

324 updated["latency_p80_ms"] = format_ms(p80) 

325 updated["latency_source"] = LATENCY_SOURCE 

326 updated["latency_warmup_ms"] = str(warmup) 

327 updated["latency_measurement_ms"] = str(iterations) 

328 updated["latency_trials"] = str(trials) 

329 return updated 

330 

331 

332def _write_csv( 

333 path: Path, fieldnames: Sequence[str], rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, str]] 

334) -> None: 

335 """Write one rewritten Pretune CSV preserving the input column order.""" 

336 try: 

337 with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream: 

338 writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(fieldnames)) 

339 writer.writeheader() 

340 for row in rows: 

341 writer.writerow({name: row.get(name, "") for name in fieldnames}) 

342 except OSError as exc: 

343 raise RebenchError(f"cannot write {path}: {exc}") from exc 

344 

345 

346def _count_of(row: Mapping[str, str]) -> Optional[int]: 

347 """Return one row's workload Count, or ``None`` when it is unavailable.""" 

348 try: 

349 count = int(row["Count"]) 

350 except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError): 

351 return None 

352 return count if count > 0 else None

355def measure_all( 

356 *, 

357 spec: Any, 

358 config_path: Path, 

359 device_runtime: Any, 

360 records_by_index: Mapping[int, Any], 

361 joined: Mapping[int, Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]]], 

362 dtype_names: Sequence[str], 

363 trials: int, 

364 repeats: int, 

365 warmup: int, 

366 iterations: int, 

367 benchmark_mode: str, 

368 benchmark_retries: int, 

369 measurement_order: str = "interleaved", 

370) -> dict[int, dict[str, list[tuple[float, float, float]]]]: 

371 """Run every sweep and return per-row, per-side, per-sweep quantiles. 

372 

373 Args: 

374 spec: Compiled operator contract shared by both Pretune runs. 

375 config_path: Operator YAML path the worker reloads. 

376 device_runtime: Runtime already probed and validated by ``main`` for the 

377 single pinned device. 

378 records_by_index: Shape records keyed by original input row index. 

379 joined: Measurable rows keyed by index, each mapping side to its row. 

380 dtype_names: Resolved ordered tensor-recipe dtype names. 

381 trials: Measurements per config per sweep. 

382 repeats: Independent sweeps over every shape. 

383 warmup: Triton warmup duration in milliseconds. 

384 iterations: Triton repetition duration in milliseconds. 

385 benchmark_mode: Architecture-neutral ``event`` or ``replay`` mode. 

386 benchmark_retries: Replay samples sharing each trial's budget. 

387 measurement_order: Label order passed to the fixed-config worker. 

388 

389 Returns: 

390 ``{index: {side: [ (p20, p50, p80) per sweep ]}}``. 

391 

392 Raises: 

393 RebenchError: If the worker cannot be constructed or a shape cannot be 

394 prepared or measured. 

395 

396 Implementation: 

397 One :class:`BenchmarkWorker` serves every sweep so tuner state and 

398 compiled kernels are reused. Sweeps are the outer loop rather than the 

399 inner one: a per-shape repeat would sample the same few seconds of 

400 machine state three times, while a repeated full sweep re-samples each 

401 shape minutes apart and is what actually exposes drift. 

402 """ 

403 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.contracts.operator import OperatorConfigError 

404 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.runtime.device import DeviceProbeError 

405 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.runtime.executor import ( 

406 BenchmarkExecutionError, 

407 BenchmarkWorker, 

408 prepare_benchmark_case, 

409 ) 

410 

411 try: 

412 worker = BenchmarkWorker(str(config_path), device_runtime=device_runtime) 

413 except (BenchmarkExecutionError, OperatorConfigError, ImportError) as exc: 

414 raise RebenchError(f"cannot start the benchmark worker: {exc}") from exc 

415 

416 payloads: dict[int, Any] = {} 

417 config_records: dict[int, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {} 

418 for index in sorted(joined): 

419 record = records_by_index.get(index) 

420 if record is None: 

421 raise RebenchError( 

422 f"input_row_index {index} is absent from the shape config; " 

423 "the CSVs and --shape-config are not from the same run" 

424 ) 

425 try: 

426 payloads[index] = prepare_benchmark_case( 

427 spec, record.to_benchmark_shape(), None, index 

428 ) 

429 except BenchmarkExecutionError as exc: 

430 raise RebenchError(f"row {index}: {exc}") from exc 

431 config_records[index] = { 

432 side: _selected_config(joined[index][side], side, index) for side in SIDES 

433 } 

434 

435 collected: dict[int, dict[str, list[tuple[float, float, float]]]] = { 

436 index: {side: [] for side in SIDES} for index in payloads 

437 } 

438 total = len(payloads) * repeats 

439 done = 0 

440 start = time.perf_counter() 

441 for sweep in range(repeats): 

442 for index in sorted(payloads): 

443 try: 

444 samples = worker.measure_configs( 

445 payloads[index], 

446 dtype_names=dtype_names, 

447 config_records=config_records[index], 

448 warmup=warmup, 

449 iterations=iterations, 

450 trials=trials, 

451 benchmark_mode=benchmark_mode, 

452 benchmark_retries=benchmark_retries, 

453 measurement_order=measurement_order, 

454 ) 

455 except (BenchmarkExecutionError, DeviceProbeError) as exc: 

456 raise RebenchError(f"row {index} sweep {sweep}: {exc}") from exc 

457 for side in SIDES: 

458 collected[index][side].append(_sweep_quantiles(samples[side])) 

459 done += 1 

460 if done % 25 == 0 or done == total: 

461 elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start 

462 print( 

463 f"[rebench] {done}/{total} measurements {elapsed:.0f}s", 

464 flush=True, 

465 ) 

466 return collected 

467 

468 

469def summarize( 

470 *, 

471 collected: Mapping[int, Mapping[str, Sequence[tuple[float, float, float]]]], 

472 joined: Mapping[int, Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]]], 

473 skipped: Sequence[int], 

474 sweeps: int, 

475 noise_floor_ms: float, 

476 threshold_pct: float, 

477) -> dict[str, Any]: 

478 """Build the machine-readable re-measurement summary. 

479 

480 Args: 

481 collected: Per-row, per-side, per-sweep quantiles from :func:`measure_all`. 

482 joined: Measurable rows keyed by index, each mapping side to its row. 

483 skipped: Indexes carried through without measurement. 

484 sweeps: Number of sweeps behind each row, which decides whether a row 

485 has an error bar at all. 

486 noise_floor_ms: Baseline latency at or below this is unresolvable. 

487 threshold_pct: Relative throughput below this is listed. 

488 

489 Returns: 

490 A JSON-compatible mapping with one entry per measured row and the 

491 aggregate ratios that are the intended acceptance metric. 

492 

493 Notes: 

494 ``sweep_spread_pct`` is the range of a row's own relative throughput 

495 across sweeps and serves as its error bar. ``regression_confirmed`` 

496 requires the shortfall below the threshold to exceed that range, so a 

497 row that moves more between sweeps than it falls behind is listed but 

498 not counted. With few sweeps the range is a coarse, deliberately 

499 conservative interval; more sweeps tighten it. A single sweep has no 

500 range to compare against, so ``regression_confirmed`` is ``None`` rather 

501 than trivially true for every row below the threshold. 

502 """ 

503 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.reporting.schema import rounded_derived, rounded_ms 

504 

505 confirmable = sweeps >= 2 

506 rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = [] 

507 for index in sorted(collected): 

508 per_side = {side: _reduce_sweeps(collected[index][side]) for side in SIDES} 

509 baseline_p50 = per_side["baseline"][1] 

510 ours_p50 = per_side["ours"][1] 

511 relative = baseline_p50 / ours_p50 * 100.0 

512 sweep_relatives = [ 

513 base[1] / ours[1] * 100.0 

514 for base, ours in zip( 

515 collected[index]["baseline"], collected[index]["ours"] 

516 ) 

517 ] 

518 source = joined[index]["baseline"] 

519 spread = max(sweep_relatives) - min(sweep_relatives) 

520 below_threshold = relative < threshold_pct 

521 rows.append( 

522 { 

523 "input_row_index": index, 

524 "variant": source.get("variant", ""), 

525 "Count": _count_of(source), 

526 "baseline_latency_p50_ms": rounded_ms(baseline_p50), 

527 "ours_latency_p50_ms": rounded_ms(ours_p50), 

528 "relative_throughput_pct": rounded_derived(relative), 

529 "sweep_relative_throughput_pct": [ 

530 rounded_derived(value) for value in sweep_relatives 

531 ], 

532 # Preserve within-sweep pairing when device frequency or 

533 # allocation effects scale both timings between sweeps. 

534 "paired_median_relative_throughput_pct": rounded_derived( 

535 statistics.median(sweep_relatives) 

536 ), 

537 "below_threshold_sweep_count": sum( 

538 value < threshold_pct for value in sweep_relatives 

539 ), 

540 "all_sweeps_below_threshold": all( 

541 value < threshold_pct for value in sweep_relatives 

542 ), 

543 "sweep_spread_pct": rounded_derived(spread), 

544 "same_config": ( 

545 joined[index]["baseline"].get("best_config") 

546 == joined[index]["ours"].get("best_config") 

547 ), 

548 "below_noise_floor": baseline_p50 <= noise_floor_ms, 

549 "below_threshold": below_threshold, 

550 "regression_confirmed": ( 

551 (below_threshold and (threshold_pct - relative) > spread) 

552 if confirmable 

553 else None 

554 ), 

555 } 

556 ) 

557 

558 equal_baseline = sum(row["baseline_latency_p50_ms"] for row in rows) 

559 equal_ours = sum(row["ours_latency_p50_ms"] for row in rows) 

560 weighted = [row for row in rows if row["Count"]] 

561 weighted_baseline = sum( 

562 row["baseline_latency_p50_ms"] * row["Count"] for row in weighted 

563 ) 

564 weighted_ours = sum(row["ours_latency_p50_ms"] * row["Count"] for row in weighted) 

565 below = [row for row in rows if row["below_threshold"]] 

566 return { 

567 "rows": rows, 

568 "aggregate": { 

569 "measured_row_count": len(rows), 

570 "skipped_row_count": len(skipped), 

571 "skipped_input_row_indexes": sorted(skipped), 

572 "equal_weight_relative_throughput_pct": rounded_derived( 

573 equal_baseline / equal_ours * 100.0 if equal_ours else None 

574 ), 

575 "count_weighted_relative_throughput_pct": rounded_derived( 

576 weighted_baseline / weighted_ours * 100.0 if weighted_ours else None 

577 ), 

578 "count_weighted_row_count": len(weighted), 

579 "median_relative_throughput_pct": rounded_derived( 

580 statistics.median(row["relative_throughput_pct"] for row in rows) 

581 ), 

582 "median_sweep_spread_pct": rounded_derived( 

583 statistics.median(row["sweep_spread_pct"] for row in rows) 

584 ), 

585 "below_threshold_row_count": len(below), 

586 "below_threshold_above_noise_floor_row_count": sum( 

587 1 for row in below if not row["below_noise_floor"] 

588 ), 

589 "regression_confirmed_row_count": ( 

590 sum(1 for row in rows if row["regression_confirmed"]) 

591 if confirmable 

592 else None 

593 ), 

594 "sweeps": sweeps, 

595 "below_noise_floor_row_count": sum( 

596 1 for row in rows if row["below_noise_floor"] 

597 ), 

598 "regression_threshold_pct": threshold_pct, 

599 "noise_floor_ms": noise_floor_ms, 

600 }, 

601 } 

602 

603 

604def _confirmed_text(value: Optional[bool]) -> str: 

605 """Render a tri-state confirmation for the summary table.""" 

606 return "n/a" if value is None else ("yes" if value else "no") 

607 

608 

609def print_summary(summary: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None: 

610 """Print the acceptance metrics and every row below the threshold.""" 

611 aggregate = summary["aggregate"] 

612 print("[rebench] fixed-config re-measurement") 

613 print(f" measured rows {aggregate['measured_row_count']}") 

614 if aggregate["skipped_row_count"]: 

615 print( 

616 f" skipped rows {aggregate['skipped_row_count']} " 

617 f"{aggregate['skipped_input_row_indexes']}" 

618 ) 

619 print( 

620 " equal-weight throughput " 

621 f"{aggregate['equal_weight_relative_throughput_pct']}%" 

622 ) 

623 print( 

624 " Count-weighted throughput " 

625 f"{aggregate['count_weighted_relative_throughput_pct']}% " 

626 f"({aggregate['count_weighted_row_count']} rows carry a Count)" 

627 ) 

628 print( 

629 " median per-row throughput " 

630 f"{aggregate['median_relative_throughput_pct']}%" 

631 ) 

632 print( 

633 " median per-row sweep spread " 

634 f"{aggregate['median_sweep_spread_pct']}% (this row's own error bar)" 

635 ) 

636 print( 

637 f" rows below {aggregate['regression_threshold_pct']}% " 

638 f"{aggregate['below_threshold_row_count']}, of which " 

639 f"{aggregate['below_threshold_above_noise_floor_row_count']} are above the " 

640 f"{aggregate['noise_floor_ms']} ms noise floor" 

641 ) 

642 if aggregate["regression_confirmed_row_count"] is None: 

643 print( 

644 " confirmed regressions n/a " 

645 "(needs at least 2 sweeps to have an error bar)" 

646 ) 

647 else: 

648 print( 

649 " confirmed regressions " 

650 f"{aggregate['regression_confirmed_row_count']} " 

651 "(shortfall exceeds that row's own sweep spread)" 

652 ) 

653 below = [row for row in summary["rows"] if row["below_threshold"]] 

654 if not below: 

655 return 

656 print( 

657 " %-5s %-13s %11s %11s %8s %8s %6s %10s" 

658 % ( 

659 "index", 

660 "variant", 

661 "baseline_ms", 

662 "ours_ms", 

663 "rel%", 

664 "spread%", 

665 "floor", 

666 "confirmed", 

667 ) 

668 ) 

669 for row in sorted(below, key=lambda item: item["relative_throughput_pct"]): 

670 print( 

671 " %-5s %-13s %11.6f %11.6f %8.1f %8.1f %6s %10s" 

672 % ( 

673 row["input_row_index"], 

674 row["variant"][:13], 

675 row["baseline_latency_p50_ms"], 

676 row["ours_latency_p50_ms"], 

677 row["relative_throughput_pct"], 

678 row["sweep_spread_pct"], 

679 "yes" if row["below_noise_floor"] else "no", 

680 _confirmed_text(row["regression_confirmed"]), 

681 ) 

682 ) 

683 

684 

685def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int: 

686 """Join, re-measure, rewrite, and summarize two Pretune artifacts.""" 

687 args = build_parser().parse_args(argv) 

688 if args.trials <= 0: 

689 raise RebenchError("--trials must be positive") 

690 if args.repeats <= 0: 

691 raise RebenchError("--repeats must be positive") 

692 if args.latency_warmup < 0: 

693 raise RebenchError("--latency-warmup must be non-negative") 

694 if args.latency_iterations <= 0: 

695 raise RebenchError("--latency-iter must be positive") 

696 if args.benchmark_retries <= 0: 

697 raise RebenchError("--benchmark-retries must be positive") 

698 if args.noise_floor_ms < 0: 

699 raise RebenchError("--noise-floor-ms must be non-negative") 

700 

701 pinned = _pin_single_device(args.device) 

702 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.cli.pretune import PretuneError, load_shape_records 

703 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.contracts.operator import ( 

704 OperatorConfigError, 

705 load_operator_benchmark_spec, 

706 ) 

707 from flag_gems.flagtune.offline.runtime.device import ( 

708 DeviceProbeError, 

709 probe_flagtune_environment, 

710 ) 

711 

712 try: 

713 environment = probe_flagtune_environment() 

714 except DeviceProbeError as exc: 

715 raise RebenchError(str(exc)) from exc 

716 if environment.device_count != 1: 

717 raise RebenchError( 

718 "re-measurement interleaves both sides in one process and needs " 

719 f"exactly one visible device, but {environment.device_count} are " 

720 f"visible with {pinned}. Export the backend visibility variable " 

721 "with a single token, for example CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0." 

722 ) 

723 

724 config_path = Path(args.flagtune_config).expanduser().resolve() 

725 shape_path = Path(args.shape_config).expanduser().resolve() 

726 output_dir = Path(args.output).expanduser().resolve() 

727 try: 

728 spec = load_operator_benchmark_spec(config_path) 

729 except (OperatorConfigError, OSError, ValueError) as exc: 

730 raise RebenchError(str(exc)) from exc 

731 

732 paths = { 

733 "baseline": Path(args.baseline).expanduser().resolve(), 

734 "ours": Path(args.ours).expanduser().resolve(), 

735 } 

736 tables = {side: _read_pretune_csv(paths[side], side) for side in SIDES} 

737 indexed = {side: _index_rows(tables[side][0], side) for side in SIDES} 

738 if set(indexed["baseline"]) != set(indexed["ours"]): 

739 missing_ours = sorted(set(indexed["baseline"]) - set(indexed["ours"])) 

740 missing_baseline = sorted(set(indexed["ours"]) - set(indexed["baseline"])) 

741 raise RebenchError( 

742 "input_row_index sets differ: " 

743 f"missing from ours={missing_ours}; " 

744 f"missing from baseline={missing_baseline}" 

745 ) 

746 

747 joined: dict[int, dict[str, dict[str, str]]] = {} 

748 skipped: list[int] = [] 

749 for index in sorted(indexed["baseline"]): 

750 pair = {side: indexed[side][index] for side in SIDES} 

751 if any(pair[side].get("status") != "ok" for side in SIDES): 

752 skipped.append(index) 

753 continue 

754 if pair["baseline"].get("variant") != pair["ours"].get("variant"): 

755 raise RebenchError( 

756 f"row {index} has variant " 

757 f"{pair['baseline'].get('variant')!r} in baseline but " 

758 f"{pair['ours'].get('variant')!r} in ours" 

759 ) 

760 joined[index] = pair 

761 if not joined: 

762 raise RebenchError("no row completed in both runs, nothing to re-measure") 

763 

764 try: 

765 records = load_shape_records(shape_path, spec) 

766 except PretuneError as exc: 

767 raise RebenchError(f"cannot load {shape_path}: {exc}") from exc 

768 records_by_index = {record.source_index: record for record in records} 

769 

770 dtype_names = _resolve_dtypes(args.dtypes, len(spec.benchmark.tensors)) 

771 collected = measure_all( 

772 spec=spec, 

773 config_path=config_path, 

774 device_runtime=environment.runtime, 

775 records_by_index=records_by_index, 

776 joined=joined, 

777 dtype_names=dtype_names, 

778 trials=args.trials, 

779 repeats=args.repeats, 

780 warmup=args.latency_warmup, 

781 iterations=args.latency_iterations, 

782 benchmark_mode=args.benchmark_mode, 

783 benchmark_retries=args.benchmark_retries, 

784 measurement_order=args.measurement_order, 

785 ) 

786 

787 output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) 

788 for side in SIDES: 

789 rows, fieldnames = tables[side] 

790 rewritten = [] 

791 for row in rows: 

792 index = int(row["input_row_index"]) 

793 if index not in collected: 

794 rewritten.append(dict(row)) 

795 continue 

796 rewritten.append( 

797 _rewrite_latency( 

798 row, 

799 _reduce_sweeps(collected[index][side]), 

800 warmup=args.latency_warmup, 

801 iterations=args.latency_iterations, 

802 trials=args.trials * args.repeats, 

803 ) 

804 ) 

805 _write_csv(output_dir / f"{side}_pretune.csv", fieldnames, rewritten) 

806 

807 summary = summarize( 

808 collected=collected, 

809 joined=joined, 

810 skipped=skipped, 

811 sweeps=args.repeats, 

812 noise_floor_ms=args.noise_floor_ms, 

813 threshold_pct=args.regression_threshold_pct, 

814 ) 

815 summary["raw_sweeps"] = collected 

816 summary["inputs"] = { 

817 "device_visibility": pinned, 

818 "baseline": str(paths["baseline"]), 

819 "ours": str(paths["ours"]), 

820 "shape_config": str(shape_path), 

821 "flagtune_config": str(config_path), 

822 "dtypes": dtype_names, 

823 } 

824 summary["protocol"] = { 

825 "latency_source": LATENCY_SOURCE, 

826 "measurement_order": args.measurement_order, 

827 "trials_per_sweep": args.trials, 

828 "sweeps": args.repeats, 

829 "latency_warmup_ms": args.latency_warmup, 

830 "latency_measurement_ms": args.latency_iterations, 

831 "benchmark_mode": args.benchmark_mode, 

832 "benchmark_retries": args.benchmark_retries, 

833 } 

834 try: 

835 (output_dir / "rebench_summary.json").write_text( 

836 json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8" 

837 ) 

838 except OSError as exc: 

839 raise RebenchError(f"cannot write the summary: {exc}") from exc 

840 

841 print_summary(summary) 

842 print(f"[rebench] artifacts in {output_dir}") 

843 return 0 

844 

845 

846if __name__ == "__main__": 

847 try: 

848 raise SystemExit(main()) 

849 except RebenchError as error: 

850 print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr) 

851 raise SystemExit(2) from error
